'''Asteroid Base''' was a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base dug into the surface of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Orflon]], near the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]]. It was the only rebel base near the Demophon system during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the period just prior to the [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]] [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], Asteroid Base coordinated efforts to evacuate rebel agents and others from the system. The base was commanded by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Erlick Frodar]], and was staffed by fourteen [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], eighteen [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], twenty hangar control/ground crew, twelve weapon support crew, thirty [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], three communications specialists, a dozen [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], seven command staff, and thirteen [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. There were also over a hundred evacuees from Demophon.<ref name="EJ" />

Armament for the base included two [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and three [[Laser/Legends|laser]] batteries. Asteroid Base also maintained a force of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] comprising two [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]], two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], a [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]], and three [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]]. The base complement also included three [[Quarren mining laser platform]]s and two [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] [[Plasma-Jet Mole Miner]]s.<ref name="EJ" />
